description: This file declares the interface for managing progress indicators within a software project, including functions to start, display, and stop progress displays, as well as test-specific declarations.

methods.name: display_throughput
methods.description: Displays the throughput information during progress.

methods.name: start_progress
methods.description: Initializes and starts a progress indicator for a repository.

methods.name: start_sparse_progress
methods.description: Initializes and starts a sparse progress indicator for a repository.

methods.name: start_delayed_progress
methods.description: Starts a delayed progress indicator for a repository.

methods.name: start_delayed_sparse_progress
methods.description: Starts a delayed sparse progress indicator for a repository.

methods.name: stop_progress_msg
methods.description: Stops the progress indicator and displays a message.

methods.name: void stop_progress(struct progress ** p_progress)
methods.description: Stops the progress indicator with a default 'done' message.
